:::{#exr-cross-entropy-general-self}

#### Entropy as a cross-entropy, for any mass function

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv) with [probability mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p$ on $\set{1, \ldots, K}$.
Show that $\crossentropyf{p}{p} = \entropyf{X}$.

:::
